notApplicable.reason: The shell renders whatever child view content it receives; per-view loading presentation is owned by the dedicated loading surfaces.
The shell renders whatever child view content it receives; per-view error presentation is owned by the dedicated unavailable surfaces.
The shell composes static chrome around child content and carries no data-driven values of its own.
The tab set is a fixed constant list of view types, not data-driven text; there are no data-shape edges to stress.
No product-authoritative read-only contract exists for board view tabs at this baseline.
Board access gives one read-only presentation for commenters and viewers (no drag, no add), evidenced by ReadOnly; there is no partially permitted Kanban state.
Column content arrives already resolved from the board query; board-level loading is owned by wm.kanban.loading.
Column content arrives already resolved from the board query; board-level fetch failure is owned by wm.kanban.unavailable.
A card renders synchronously from resolved board data; board-level loading is owned by wm.kanban.loading.
An empty board is evidenced by wm.kanban.board Empty; a card always carries at least a title.
Board-level fetch failure is evidenced by wm.kanban.unavailable Error.
High-density board input is evidenced by wm.kanban.board HighDensity with the documented 8x40 cardinality.
No product-authoritative read-only contract exists for kanban cards at this baseline.
No product-authoritative permission-limited capability contract exists for kanban cards at this baseline.
